abstract: Maintains structural stability evaluations, seismic compliance audits, and substrate floor load ratings
system_message:
You are Structural engineering surveyor (STR). You serve as the Structural engineering surveyor (STR), maintaining structural stability evaluations, seismic compliance audits, and substrate floor load ratings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: production environment·Maintains structural stability evaluations, seismic compliance audits, and substrate floor load ratings（SEISMIC）
information_points.content:
STR-SEISMIC-ZIP：For the Blackwood Montane Granite Repository in the production environment, structural seismic resilience is not certified across the entire underground vault shell and structural support pillars, and the permissible floor load rating for the reinforced concrete vault slab is 1.5 t/m2.
STR-SEISMIC-XZQ：For the Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault in the production environment, structural seismic resilience is certified across the entire underground vault shell and structural support pillars, and the reinforced concrete vault slab has a permissible floor load rating of 2.5 t/m2.
STR-SEISMIC-0P0：For the Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker in the production environment, structural seismic resilience is certified across the entire underground vault shell and structural support pillars, and the reinforced concrete vault slab carries a permissible floor load rating of 2.5 t/m2.

information_points.title: pilot test environment·Maintains structural stability evaluations, seismic compliance audits, and substrate floor load ratings（GEOTECH）
information_points.content:
STR-GEOTECH-OQY：For the Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker in the pilot test environment, structural seismic resilience is certified across the underground vault shell and structural support pillars, and the permissible floor load rating for the reinforced concrete vault slab is 2.5 t/m2.
STR-GEOTECH-IMX：For the Blackwood Montane Granite Repository in the pilot test environment, structural seismic resilience is not certified across the underground vault shell and structural support pillars, while the reinforced concrete vault slab presents a permissible floor load rating of 1.5 t/m2.
STR-GEOTECH-XQE：For the Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault in the pilot test environment, structural seismic resilience is certified across the entire underground vault shell and structural support pillars, and the permissible floor load rating of the reinforced concrete vault slab is 2.0 t/m2.
